title: Cordillia gives his name and birth in Baton Rouge, 1899
summary: Charles Cordillia states his name and that he was born in Baton Rouge on May 25, 1899; a question about his middle name is confirmed as Joseph.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: My name is Charlie Joseph Cadilla. I was born in Baton Rouge, May the 25th, 1899. Joe, is your middle name? Joseph. Charles Joseph. Yes, doctor.
